Ana Başlık: Design and development of products and services
Eski Metin: For production parts and approval of components from sub-tier suppliers, the organization shall comply with the AIAG Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) manual and Ford’s Global Phased PPAP available through https://web.qpr.ford.com/sta/Phased_PPAP.html . Additional requirements are specified in Q1 https://web.qpr.ford.com/sta/Q1.html. Per PPAP, the organization shall submit via WERS all organization-initiated design change proposals, unless the organization or sub-tier supplier does not have access to WERS. STA will not grant full PPAP approval by if the part or manufacturing process is under WERS Alert, per exception management process. See https://web.qpr.ford.com/sta/Phased_PPAP.html
Yeni Metin: For production parts and approval of components from sub-tier suppliers, the organization shall comply with the AIAG Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) manual and Ford’s Global Phased PPAP available through the Supplier Quality Hub. Per Ford requirements, where Part Submission Warrant (PSW) is referenced, electronic PSW (ePSW) is the default Production warrant submission process. Exceptions to the ePSW process that may require use of the paper PSW submission include SREA, Directed Tier 2, Capacity Uplift, and Bulk material related PPAPs. See Phased PPAP Handbook available through the Supplier Quality Hub for PPAP level and PSW submission requirements. Per PPAP, the organization shall submit a deviation via WERS or Jira for all organization-initiated design change proposals, unless the organization or sub-tier supplier does not have access to WERS or Jira. STA will not grant full PPAP approval by if the part or manufacturing process is under WERS Alert or Jira Deviation, per exception management process. See PPAP section of the Supplier Quality Hub.
